Anything at or above 50000 pence (£500) is invoiced, not linked, per the 3 Sep 2026 rule, so it does not belong in this file.
_SOURCE: Aligned to public.service_catalogue on 3 Sep 2026 by founder instruction, using founding_pence. docs/services.html was moved to match in the same change, so the site, the catalogue and these links now agree. If you change a price, change all three.
_FOUNDING_RATE_WARNING: These are founding rates, which the site limits to the first five clients per service. A payment link does not enforce that: it keeps taking the founding price from anyone who has the URL, for as long as it is active. When the five are gone, create standard-rate links (full_pence in the catalogue), swap the buttons, and deactivate the founding links in the Stripe Dashboard.
_NOT_INCLUDED: Project Setup Pack (£399 founding) and Document Pack Check (£99 founding) are in the catalogue but have no card on docs/services.html, so there is no button to wire a link to. Oversight Retainer On The Ground (£600 founding) is the same. Add the service cards first if you want links for them. The Visual Check and Technical Sign-off express tiers and the £895 weekly retainer were removed from the site in this change because no catalogue row backs them.
